fields.description: Save magic 'Waka' at start of each 32KB flash bank. FUN_0801eba4 rejects the bank and writes defaults when this word mismatches.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 reads a 0x8000-byte bank via FUN_0802615c(0,0,buf,0x8000) then checks *piVar1 != _DAT_0801ede0; baseline has 0x57 0x61 0x6B 0x61 at file offsets 0 and 0x8000.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: First gameplay progress byte of the save payload; default-initialized to 0 by FUN_0801eba4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init sequence (*_DAT_0801ede4 = 0, then 1, 2, 2) matches baseline payload bytes 00 01 02 02 at save offsets 0xD14-0xD17; payload base 0xD14 verified non-blank in baseline.
fields.name: puzzle_pack_progress

fields.description: Second progress byte (packs/unlocks count); default-initialized to 1 by FUN_0801eba4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init stores 1 as the second header value (*_DAT_0801ede8 = 1); baseline byte at save offset 0xD15 is 0x01.
fields.name: packs_unlocked

fields.description: Stage cursor component A; default-initialized to 2 by FUN_0801eba4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init stores 2 as the third header value (*_DAT_0801edec = 2); baseline byte at save offset 0xD16 is 0x02.
fields.name: stage_cursor_a

fields.description: Stage cursor component B; default-initialized to 2 by FUN_0801eba4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init stores 2 as the fourth header value (*_DAT_0801edf0 = 2); baseline byte at save offset 0xD17 is 0x02.
fields.name: stage_cursor_b

fields.description: 32-bit slot state word (low bytes reserved-zero, high byte set to 1 by defaults); baseline 0x01000000 LE.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init writes 0,0,0,1 across the next four header bytes (*_DAT_0801edf4.._DAT_0801ee00); baseline bytes at save offsets 0xD18-0xD1B are 00 00 00 01.
fields.name: slot_state_word

fields.description: Reserved header tail; all zeros in baseline (fresh save).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init zeroes the remaining header words (*_DAT_0801ee04, *_DAT_0801ee08, _DAT_0801ee0c region); baseline bytes at save offsets 0xD1C-0xD27 are all 0x00.
fields.name: header_reserved

fields.description: Five u32 stage/puzzle clear words copied between flash image and RAM; all zero (nothing cleared) in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 copies 5 words (loop uVar14 < 5) from flash image to RAM and FUN_0801eec4 gathers them back; baseline bytes at save offsets 0xD28-0xD3B are all 0x00.
fields.name: puzzle_clear_words

fields.description: Fifty u16 score/time record entries copied between flash image and RAM; all zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 copies 0x32 u16 entries (loop uVar14 < 0x32) and FUN_0801eec4 gathers them back; baseline bytes at save offsets 0xD3C-0xD9F are all 0x00.
fields.name: time_record_table

fields.description: 0x139 state/flag bytes (per-stage unlock and play flags) copied between flash image and RAM; all zero in baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 copies 0x139 bytes (loop uVar14 < 0x139) and FUN_0801eec4 gathers them back; baseline bytes at save offsets 0xDA0-0xED8 are all 0x00.
fields.name: play_state_flags

fields.description: Trailing guard byte 0xFF just before the slot marker; possibly an erased-flash default or all-set flag nibble.
fields.evidence: Baseline byte at save offset 0xED9 is 0xFF inside an otherwise zero payload written by the FUN_0801eba4/FUN_0801eec4 save path; no decomp store identified, so kept as a guard byte.
fields.name: footer_guard

fields.description: Active-slot marker byte; default-initialized to 4 by FUN_0801eba4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801eba4 default-init stores *puVar3 = 4 for the trailing slot marker; baseline byte at save offset 0xEDA is 0x04.
fields.name: active_slot_marker

fields.description: Stored CRC-32 of bank block 0 (bytes 0x0000-0x0FFF of the bank) computed with the 36-byte table at 0xFDC zeroed. Baseline verified.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801ea90 accumulates CRC-32 via the FUN_0801ea64 bit step; FUN_0801eec4 builds one CRC per 0x1000 block and FUN_0801eb20 verifies them. Python CRC-32-IEEE of bank bytes 0x0000-0x0FFF with 0xFDC-0xFFF zeroed equals the stored word.
fields.name: crc_block_0

fields.description: Stored CRC-32 of bank block 1 (all-erased 0xFF fill in baseline). Baseline verified.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801ea90/FUN_0801ea64 CRC-32 path, one CRC per 0x1000 block built by FUN_0801eec4 and verified by FUN_0801eb20. Python CRC-32-IEEE of the block equals the stored word.
fields.name: crc_block_1
